diagnostics.dark_text: Button text will be dark on this color, to stay readable.
diagnostics.gray: With no hue, the interface will be neutral — that’s allowed.
diagnostics.light_text: Button text will be light on this color, to stay readable.
diagnostics.links_darkened: Links and brand-colored text will be darkened to stay readable; buttons keep the chosen color.
diagnostics.too_dark_flipped: A color this dark can’t get any darker: hover and pressed states will be lightened.
diagnostics.too_dark_for_theme: This color is too dark for this theme: the system lightens it for buttons and links.
diagnostics.too_light: This color is too light to carry a button: the system darkens it for buttons and links, and keeps its hue for light backgrounds.
diagnostics.too_light_flipped: A color this light can’t get any lighter: hover and pressed states will be darkened.
diagnostics.vivid: This color is very vivid: links and light backgrounds will be softened to stay readable.
